# Waddat Drinks

> Waddat Drinks is a premium beverage brand handcrafting authentic Jamaican-inspired bottled fruit drinks and wildcrafted sea moss tonics. Rooted in Caribbean family heritage, our recipes use 100% natural ingredients, real tropical fruit, fresh spices, and zero artificial preservatives.

Waddat Drinks brings traditional Caribbean refreshment to modern lifestyles. From fiery Jamaican Ginger and spiced Sorrel to nutrient-dense Pineapple and Soursop Sea Moss tonics, every drink is brewed with authentic recipes passed down through generations.

## Product Range

- [Jamaican Ginger Beer](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/ginger/): Fiery, authentic Jamaican ginger drink crafted with real ginger root, citrus, and traditional aromatic spices.
- [Jamaican Sorrel Drink](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/sorrel-drink/): Deep ruby spiced hibiscus infusion brewed with fragrant cloves, ginger, and pimento (allspice).
- [Island Lemonade](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Lemonade/): Crisp, refreshing tropical lemonade made with real lemons and balanced sweetness.
- [Pineapple Sea Moss Tonic](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Pineapple-Sea-Moss/): Nutrient-rich tonic combining wildcrafted ocean sea moss with sweet, tropical pineapple juice, delivering 92 of the body's 102 essential minerals.
- [Soursop Sea Moss Tonic](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Soursop-Sea-Moss/): Nutrient-packed blend of wildcrafted sea moss and creamy, aromatic tropical soursop (guanábana) fruit pulp.

## Key Attributes & Benefits

- 100% natural ingredients with real roots, flowers, and fruit purees
- Wildcrafted sea moss rich in 92 essential minerals (iron, magnesium, calcium, iodine, zinc)
- Natural digestive and immunity support
- Free from artificial preservatives, colorings, and synthetic flavorings
- Authentic Jamaican family recipes
